decisions.reason: The minimum quantity lubrication line sits close to the core machine-tool customer base and fits sustainability demand, so performance likely meets aspirations, and an expanding firm has the slack to carry it despite missing website evidence.

The hydrocyclone filter extends the established coolant filtration platform with low incremental cost, and in a growing industry with no evident shortfall there is no trigger for problemistic search that would justify dropping it.

Gravity band filters are a standard modular element of the firm's complete coolant systems and support one-stop delivery, so keeping them is consistent with satisficing behavior while the firm expands.
